summary: AbCellera Biologics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 17,435,897 common shares and, in lieu, pre-funded warrants for 3,076,926 shares at a public offering price of $9.75 per share (warrant price $9.74999), raising roughly $200 million before fees. The last sale was $10.36 on August 12, 2026, implying a discount. Underwriters include Jefferies, J.P. Morgan, Cantor, UBS, and BMO. This is a standard capital raise, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
